ns2:course.label: Kinem & Dynamics of Mech Syst
ns2:course.description: Kinematics and dynamics of constrained rigid-body mechanical systems; use of modern computer-based analysis software packages. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 370.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 370.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
